documentedRules: A paid spin debits the selected bet once; this is not a free-respin feature.
Nonparticipating wilds stay in the same cell and increase their own multiplier by1 on each new paid spin.
Wilds participating in awarded winning combinations multiply that award and are removed; other wilds remain.
Carry state is linked to the exact selected bet. Switching bets saves the old state and restores the bucket when that bet is selected again.
Multi Fruits ANTE5x/10x changes the actual debit and initial wild multiplier; two participating ANTE wild multipliers add according to the relevant Help clause.
transactionContract: Read the selected bet/profile carry bucket under the same account transaction lock as stake admission.
Calculate complete next-spin potential liability using stored wild multipliers before accepting the new paid stake. Reject an unaffordable stake without changing the saved wild state.
Store the accepted round input carry, result, resulting carry bucket and wallet/ledger changes atomically.
A duplicate request replay must not debit, increment, remove or re-save wild state again.
Reload/state/history are read-only and must never advance charges.
Changing bet must select another saved bucket; it must not overwrite or transfer the old multipliers.
unresolved: Ordinary multiple-wild multiplier combination is not fully explicit outside the ANTE clause; do not silently copy an ANTE-only rule.
Provider probabilities and a maximum charging multiplier are not established.
Exact symbol paytable and line chart remain unverified.
implementationGap: The current synchronous adapter.start receives stake/options/RNG but no transactionally loaded player/bet carry context. A one-spin approximation would not implement these rules. Prepared runtime integration needs a retained-service transaction hook or equivalent server context; a browser-supplied carry object or in-memory global map is unacceptable.
financialGate: Persistent charging remains disabled/unimplemented until the atomic retained-wallet carry contract and configured account/game/house liability policy are verified.
